name: inv-2-fan-errors-via-factory
description: F1 PR-D: fan-budget-refused and fan-child-failed errors are constructed only through frameworkError factories, so every refusal carries the redeploy hint, lower-bound flag and estimator-applied fields. Line-based: flags the kind followed by a comma, the kind as the last property after another one (`, kind: "fan-…" }`), and the kind alone at the end of a line (last property of a multi-line literal); an optional `as const` is tolerated. A kind-only `{ kind: "fan-…" }` (ts-pattern arm or P.union entry) is not flagged: it lacks the required nodeId/refusal or primary/causes fields, so tsc rejects it as a FrameworkError and it can only be a match pattern. Type members (`;`), zod `z.literal(…)` and comparisons never match.
fixHint: Build the error with frameworkError.fanBudgetRefused(...) / frameworkError.fanChildFailed(...) from packages/framework/src/types/error-factories.ts instead of an object literal.
